name: Step header
purpose: Numbered step with large numeral, '/ total', heading and body, replacing progress bars.

implementation.api: Studio.comp.stepHeader(parent, {index, total, title, body}).enter(tl, at) / .exit(tl, at)

layout_notes: Stacks vertically in all formats; numeral size scales with --fs-numeral (largest in portrait).
validation_steps: npx hyperframes check on the render host

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/test-studio-runtime.py and frame review of projects/masala-chai-recipe (landscape, portrait, square) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
